subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the corresponding
stimulus: numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1  8 = 8 (a) Socrates met his friends and disciples for the last times. (b) Then there came a man with a cup in hand. (c) With eyes full of tears, they bade Socrates the last farewell. (d) He told them that the soul of man cannot die. (e) He argued with them about the immortality of soul. (f) At last, the hour of departure had arrived. (g) At sunset, the Governor of the prison came. (h) The cup contained hemlock, a very strong poison and Socrates took the cup in his hand and drank hemlock without any hesitation. Part−B : Writing Test [50 Marks]
guide_solution: Rearranging 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 g d e a b c f h Winston Churchill (1874-1965), a great statesman, served as a soldier in India and Egypt, and as a journalist in South Africa. He was a Member of Parliament from 1900 to 1965, for five different constituencies. When Neville Chamberlain was forced to resign in 1940, Churchill became Prime Minister and Minister of Defense. His radio speeches during World War II gave the British people a strong determination to win the war. The conservative party, led by Churchill lost the election of 1945. But he became Prime Minister again from 1951 to 1955 when he retired at the age of 80. He was made a knight in 1953, the same year in which he won the Nobel Prize for literature. He is remembered with great affection in both Britain and the US. Part−B : Writing Test 251 See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book
